transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you here today?

I guess… the main thing is I’m not sleeping right. I’ll lie there going over work stuff, arguments at home, and then I’m up around 3 or 4. By morning it feels like I never really rested. That’s what finally made me call the employee assistance program.
When you're trying to fall asleep, do you have trouble staying asleep or do you wake up a few hours after going to bed and can't get back to sleep?

Yeah… both, I guess. I have trouble falling asleep because I’m replaying work stuff or arguments at home, and then I’ll wake up around 3 or 4 and can’t really get settled again. By morning I feel like I didn’t rest.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you usually like doing?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to actually look forward to pickup basketball, bowling with friends, stuff like that. Even having people over and using the smoker. Lately I’ve been canceling more, or if I go, I’m kind of just… there. Going through the motions.
Have you noticed feeling down, depressed, or hopeless most days?
Yeah… most days, I think. It’s like this heavy, gray feeling that kind of follows me around—from work to the car, then home. Even when nothing’s really happening, I just feel… hollow, I guess.
Have you noticed that you feel tired or have less energy most days, even when you haven’t done much physically?
I don’t know… I mean, I’m tired sometimes, but I haven’t really paid attention to whether it’s most days or anything.
Has there been a time in the past few weeks when you felt no pleasure or interest in anything at all, even things you used to enjoy?

Yeah… there have been times like that. Stuff I used to look forward to—basketball, bowling, festivals, having friends over and using the smoker—I just don’t really care about it lately. I’ll cancel, or if I do go, I’m kind of just… there.
Do you find that you feel tired or have little energy most days, even when you haven’t done much physically?
I’m not really sure. I get tired, yeah, but I don’t know if it’s most days or just… normal tired. I haven’t been tracking it.
Do you feel down, depressed, or hopeless most days?
Yeah… most days, I guess. It’s like this heavy, gray feeling kind of follows me around—from work to the car, then home. Nothing even has to be wrong, I just feel… hollow.
Have you felt this way—down, depressed, or losing interest in things—for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row?
Yeah… I think so. It’s been more than two weeks. Honestly, it’s been going on for… maybe a year and a couple months, since things at home started getting worse.
Can you tell me more about what’s been going on at home that’s been making things worse?
I don’t know… it’s just been tense. Stuff I’d rather not get into too much. Home doesn’t really feel like a place where I can relax lately.
Have you experienced days where nothing—not even things you used to really enjoy—feels good or interesting at all?

Yeah… I mean, I used to actually look forward to stuff—pickup basketball, bowling with friends, going to music festivals, smoking meat for people. Lately I either cancel, or if I do show up, I’m just kind of… there. Not really enjoying it.
Have you noticed yourself getting more irritable or easily annoyed lately, even over small things?
I’m not really sure. Maybe a little, but I haven’t been paying that much attention to it.
Have you found yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or feeling restless and agitated, like you can’t sit still?

A little, yeah. I don’t think other people at work would say I’m falling apart or anything, but I notice it. I’ll sit there staring at my laptop longer than I should, and sometimes when one of my reps asks me something simple, it takes me a second to answer. Just… slower, I guess.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently—like eating a lot more or a lot less than usual?
Yeah… somewhat. My appetite’s been kind of off for a while. I’ll get through lunch on just coffee, then barely eat much at dinner. But somehow my belt’s still a notch tighter than it used to be.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things more than usual, or feeling like you’re not worth much?

Yeah… I guess I have. I try not to sit with it too much, but I keep going over stuff in my head—late nights at work, tailgates, stupid things I bought—and it turns into this feeling like my wife and kids ended up with someone selfish. Like I’m letting them down.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or feeling restless and agitated, like you can’t sit still, most days?

Yeah… most days, I think. Like I said, I don’t think anyone at work would make a big thing of it, but I can tell. I’ll just sit there staring at my laptop, and when one of my reps asks me something easy, it takes me a second longer than it should to answer. Just… slower than usual.
Have you found yourself thinking about death or dying, or wishing you were dead, even if you wouldn’t act on it?
Yeah… I mean, not like I’m planning anything. I’m not. But… sometimes the thought comes up that maybe it’d be easier for everybody if I just didn’t wake up. More than I really like to admit.
Have these feelings and changes in your mood affected your ability to function normally at work, at home, or with friends?

Yeah… somewhat. I’m still going in and doing what I have to do, but I’m not as sharp. My team’s had to pick up some slack when I miss things with forecasts or I’m not ready enough for a client call.

At home… I’m there, but I’m not really there the way I used to be. My wife and kids notice, I think.
